profile.headline: Software Engineer and Researcher
profile.summary: I am a dedicated and versatile software developer with over 20 years of professional experience in enterprise software engineering and development, applied research, mobile computing, and wireless networks. I have practical experience and comfortable working in Python, Java, Python Pandas, Docker, Django and Flask web frameworks,  SQL, and HTML/Javascript.

positions.title: SME Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: I am a software engineer primarily contracting for the Naval Research Laboratory

positions.title: Software Engineer/Developer
positions.description:
- Software developer and engineering specialist for the XMPP Overlay Service (XO), an  XMPP-based serverless chat middleware.
- Designed and built a reporting system using the Python Django Web Framework and Pandas. The system ingests, processes, and displays user activity for a financial services web application.
- Built a prototype for Android mobile devices to help hearing impaired individuals learn lip reading.
- Built a Python Flask-based web services endpoint for generating and managing authentication credentials.

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description: Software engineering, software development, network emulation, Android development at the Applied Informatics Group for the College of Computing and Informatics at Drexel University

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Graduate student working at the Drexel's Applied Communications and Information Networking Program in Camden, NJ. My research focus was on applied artificial intelligence for resource constrained and challenged network environments, knowledge representation, and ontology development.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Discrete Math and Logic, Computer Science
